response.sql:
WITH city_counts AS (
  SELECT c.location AS city, COUNT(q.qualifyId) AS qualifying_count
  FROM circuits AS c
  LEFT JOIN races AS r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  LEFT JOIN qualifying AS q ON q.raceId = r.raceId
  GROUP BY c.location
), totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(qualifying_count) AS total_qualifying,
         COUNT(*) AS city_count
  FROM city_counts
), shares AS (
  SELECT cc.city,
         cc.qualifying_count,
         1.0 * cc.qualifying_count / t.total_qualifying AS share,
         1.0 / t.city_count AS average_share
  FROM city_counts AS cc
  CROSS JOIN totals AS t
)
SELECT city,
       qualifying_count,
       share,
       share - average_share AS above_average_share
FROM shares
WHERE share > average_share
ORDER BY city

assumptions.assumption: A city is a distinct circuits.location; the average is across all such cities, including cities with no qualifying records. Shares and their difference are returned as unrounded fractions.

alternatives.interpretation: If “average city share” means the average only among cities with at least one qualifying record, use this query.
